title: MultiInpaintCOCO: Fine-Grained Visual Understanding in Multiple Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.03309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Previous research shows that vision-language (VL) models struggle to understand fine-grained image details and tend to focus on the overall layout. Moreover, any weakness in English tends to be further amplified in the multilingual setting. To study that, we extend InpaintCOCO, an English dataset focused on fine-grained visual details, to 13 typologically diverse languages across five language families, creating MultiInpaintCOCO - a new multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples. We further test several state-of-the-art models in multilingual multimodal retrieval, considering both light VL CLIP-like encoders and large language models. Our results show that performance degrades substantially for lower-resource languages, with the strongest predictor being the data resources available for the languages rather than typological similarity to English. In cross-lingual retrieval, most models exhibit a systematic bias toward English: w

translated_title: MultiInpaintCOCO：多语言细粒度视觉理解
translated_abstract: 先前的研究表明，视觉-语言（VL）模型难以理解图像的细粒度细节，往往只关注整体布局。此外，模型在英语上的任何弱点在多语言环境中往往会被进一步放大。为了研究这一问题，我们将InpaintCOCO（一个专注于细粒度视觉细节的英语数据集）扩展到涵盖五个语系的13种类型学上多样化的语言，创建了MultiInpaintCOCO——一个包含953个最小对示例的新型多语言基准。我们进一步在多语言多模态检索任务中测试了多个最先进的模型，既包括轻量级的类CLIP视觉-语言编码器，也包括大型语言模型。我们的结果表明，低资源语言的性能显著下降，而最强的预测因素是该语言可用的数据资源，而非与英语的类型学相似度。在跨语言检索中，大多数模型表现出对英语的系统性偏差：w……
tldr: 该论文提出MultiInpaintCOCO——一个覆盖13种语言、包含953个最小对示例的多语言细粒度视觉理解基准，发现视觉-语言模型在低资源语言上性能显著下降，其主因是语言数据资源的匮乏而非与英语的类型学相似度，且模型在跨语言检索中存在对英语的系统性偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MultiInpaintCOCO, a multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples across 13 languages for fine-grained visual understanding, showing that VL models degrade substantially on lower-resource languages—driven mainly by available data resources rather than typological similarity to English—and exhibit a systematic bias toward English in cross-lingual retrieval.
